design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: WQv is calculated as (P)(Rv)(A)/12, where P is the rainfall depth (1.0 inch in the Eastern Rainfall Zone, 0.9 inch in the Western Rainfall Zone), Rv is the volumetric runoff coefficient (0.05 + 0.009 * I), and A is the site area in acres.

evidence.excerpt: Rainfall Depths Associated with the 1,2,10 and 100-year, 24-hour Storm Events
WQv = (1.0) (Rv)(A) Eastern Rainfall Zone ... WQv = (0.9) (Rv)(A) Western Rainfall Zone ... where: WQv = water quality volume (in acre-feet) Rv = 0.05 + 0.009(I)
